slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣

第1158章初始信标
初始信标的叩击频率被秦岳从渊墟穹顶最深处完整提取出来之后。
守远号在渊墟之门前方悬停了整整一天。
不是不想动。
是秦岳要求恒光把所有能调动的信标阵列全部切换到交叉定位模式。
先把这组叩击的来源方向精确锁定再说。
他吃不准这组叩击的衰减曲线。
它太古老了。
古老到叩击的共振结构在穿透渊墟穹顶的封印层之后已经衰减了好几轮。
嵌套在最底层的定位信息几乎被渊墟导航信标的同频共振淹没。
秦岳把初始信标的叩击频率与渊墟导航信标主频做了逐帧剥离。
一层一层地剖开。
剖到最后一层时他在感应屏前沉默了好一会儿。
然后拿起叩应器朝舰桥广播。
“初始信标不是单点。它的叩击结构和渊墟信标、叩渊者信标一样，是一套由大量独立节点组成的分布式信标阵列。每一座信标都在叩同一句话——‘此叩为始。初始信标，叩以待复。’”
恒光在右翼使节舰上同步校准全域预警阵列。
把初始信标所有节点的叩击信号按相位差排列。
在灵图上铺成一张极其熟悉又极其陌生的拓扑图。
极其熟悉，是因为它的排列方式与三界接力器部署逻辑完全一致。
与叩渊者信标阵列完全一致。

与渊墟导航信标阵列完全一致。
以核心发射源为圆心，数十个节点呈同心圆状层层扩散。
每一层节点之间的共振相位差都精准对应建造者信标叩击主频的谐波分量。
极其陌生，是因为它的覆盖范围远超渊墟导航信标阵列的总和。
核心发射源的位置在三网当前探测极限之外的极远空域。
远到连恒光把全域预警阵列的灵敏度提到理论极限也只能勉强锁定一个极模糊的方向。
秦岳把恒光的交叉定位数据与渊墟星图做了叠加比对。
发现初始信标阵列的部署航线恰好沿着渊墟星图边缘那片尚未被任何探测手段覆盖的绝对空白区域。
一路往更深更远更暗的方向延伸。
渊墟在亘古前收到初始信标的叩击之后，沿着它的部署方向铺设了导航信标。
但他们没有铺到初始信标核心发射源的位置。
不是不想铺。
是初始信标距离太远，渊墟的资源耗尽之前只够铺到叩渊者能收到的地方。
“渊墟的导航信标为什么铺到这个位置就停了——不是他们不想继续铺，是初始信标从核心发射源到渊墟接收点的距离，远超渊墟文明全盛时期的资源总量。他们把所有能用的共振合金全部熔铸成信标阵列，也只够铺到叩渊者能收到的地方。再往外铺，渊墟自己就撑不住了。”
秦岳的声音压得极稳极沉。
“所以他们在穹顶叩击文最深处封存了初始信标的叩击记录，标注为‘未解明信标’，等待后继文明有更先进的探测手段之后继续追。”
朔站在舰桥舷窗前。
用自己的探测共振朝秦岳标注的初始信标方向叩了一声极长极稳极安宁的叩击。
说渊墟铺到极限，叩渊者铺到极限。
现在三网枢纽协议的共振补偿技术可以覆盖极低共振环境下的信标阵列部署。

他们铺不动的地方，我们替他们铺。
沈无名下令舰队沿初始信标叩击方向全速推进。
content_en:
Chapter 1158 Initial Beacon
After Qin Yue completely extracted the tapping frequency of the initial beacon from the deepest part of the Yuanxu dome.
The Shouyuan hovered in front of the Yuanxu Gate for a whole day.
It’s not that I don’t want to move.
It was Qin Yue who asked Hengguang to switch all mobilizable beacon arrays to cross-positioning mode.
First, let’s pinpoint the source direction of this group of taps.
He couldn't figure out the attenuation curve of this set of taps.
It's too old.
The resonance structure, which is so old that it strikes, has decayed for several rounds after penetrating the sealing layer of the Yuanxu dome.
The positioning information nested at the lowest level was almost drowned by the same-frequency resonance of the Yuanxu navigation beacon.
Qin Yue separated the tapping frequency of the initial beacon from the main frequency of the Yuanxu navigation beacon frame by frame.
Cut open layer by layer.
When he reached the last layer, he was silent for a long time in front of the sensor screen.
Then he picked up the clicker and broadcast to the bridge.
"The initial beacon is not a single point. Its tapping structure is the same as the Yuanxu beacon and the Abyss beacon. It is a distributed beacon array composed of a large number of independent nodes. Each beacon is tapping the same sentence - 'This tap is the beginning. The initial beacon taps to wait for a reply.'"
Hengguang simultaneously calibrated the global early warning array on the right wing envoy ship.
Arrange the tapping signals of all nodes of the initial beacon according to the phase difference.
A topological map that is extremely familiar yet extremely unfamiliar is laid out on the spiritual map.
It is extremely familiar because its arrangement is completely consistent with the deployment logic of the Three Realms Relay.
Exactly the same as the Knocker's beacon array.
It is completely consistent with the Yuanxu navigation beacon array.
With the core emission source as the center of the circle, dozens of nodes spread out in concentric circles.
The resonance phase difference between nodes on each layer accurately corresponds to the harmonic component of the builder's beacon tapping frequency.
It is extremely unfamiliar because its coverage far exceeds the sum of the Yuanxu navigation beacon array.
The location of the core emission source is in the extremely distant airspace beyond the current detection limits of the three networks.
It's so far away that even if Hengguang raises the sensitivity of the global early warning array to its theoretical limit, it can barely lock on to an extremely vague direction.
Qin Yue overlaid and compared Hengguang's cross-positioning data with the Yuanxu star map.
It was discovered that the deployment route of the initial beacon array happened to be along the absolutely blank area at the edge of the Yuanxu star map that had not been covered by any detection means.
All the way extending in a deeper, farther and darker direction.
After Yuanxu received the tap of the initial beacon eons ago, it laid a navigation beacon along its deployment direction.
But they did not reach the location of the initial beacon core emission source.
It’s not that I don’t want to pave.
The initial beacon is too far away, and before the resources of Yuanxu are exhausted, it can only be spread to a place where those who knock on the Yuanxu can receive it.
"Why did Yuanxu's navigation beacon stop at this position? It's not that they didn't want to continue laying it out. It was because the distance between the initial beacon from the core transmitting source to Yuanxu's receiving point far exceeded the total resources of Yuanxu civilization in its heyday. They melted all the available resonance alloys into the beacon array, and it was only enough to spread it to a place where those who knocked on the Yuanxu could receive it. If they spread it any further, Yuanxu itself would not be able to support it."
Qin Yue's voice was very steady and deep.
"So they sealed the tapping record of the initial beacon in the deepest part of the dome tapping text, marking it as an 'unexplained beacon', waiting for subsequent civilizations to continue to pursue it after they have more advanced detection methods."
Shuo stood in front of the porthole of the bridge.
He used his own detection resonance to knock in the direction of the initial beacon marked by Qin Yue with a very long, stable and peaceful knock.
Those who say Yuanxu is spread to the limit, and those who knock the Yuanxu are spread to the limit.
Now the resonance compensation technology of the three-network hub protocol can cover the deployment of beacon arrays in extremely low resonance environments.
Where they cannot pave, we will pave for them.
Shen Wuming ordered the fleet to advance at full speed in the direction of the initial beacon strike.
